# Veritas Hospitality Advisors

> Profit-focused hospitality consulting and independent hotel owner advisory for India. Veritas works only for independent hotel and resort owners — reviewing commercial performance, operational governance and owner reporting. It does not operate hotels and takes no commissions from OTAs, vendors or brands. Founded by Vaishakh Surendran.

Contact: vaishakh@veritashospitalityadvisors.com · +91 90722 33008 · Registered in Kerala, India; works with owners across India.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://aisearch-global.github.io/veritas-hospitality-advisors-site/): overview, mandate, engagement model and FAQ
- [Founder — Vaishakh Surendran](https://aisearch-global.github.io/veritas-hospitality-advisors-site/founder.html): 25+ years in hospitality across India, the Maldives, Kuwait and the USA; General Manager roles since 2015; awards and credentials
- [Clients](https://aisearch-global.github.io/veritas-hospitality-advisors-site/clients.html): current engagement — Sanskreti The Heritage, Kumbalanghi, Kochi
- [Perspectives](https://aisearch-global.github.io/veritas-hospitality-advisors-site/insights.html): articles for independent hotel owners
- [Hotel owner FAQ](https://aisearch-global.github.io/veritas-hospitality-advisors-site/faq.html): 100 direct answers on owner governance, financial control, remote advisory, revenue, GOP, OTAs, brands and contracts, opening, turnaround, F&B, AI and city-level demand in India

## Services

- [Commercial Performance](https://aisearch-global.github.io/veritas-hospitality-advisors-site/commercial-performance.html): pricing and yield, OTA channel mix, benchmarking, demand segmentation, forecasting
- [Operational Governance](https://aisearch-global.github.io/veritas-hospitality-advisors-site/operational-governance.html): standards (LSOP) audit, manpower analysis, cost control, procurement review, service quality
- [Owner Reporting & Value](https://aisearch-global.github.io/veritas-hospitality-advisors-site/owner-reporting.html): revenue dashboards, monthly P&L summaries, GOP analysis, action plans

## Tools

- [Hotel Performance Diagnostic](https://aisearch-global.github.io/veritas-hospitality-advisors-site/diagnostic.html): 15-question owner self-assessment
- [Hotel Profit Health Check](https://aisearch-global.github.io/veritas-hospitality-advisors-site/health-check.html): estimate revenue yield, OTA cost drag and three profit gaps
- [Owner's Oversight Playbook (PDF)](https://aisearch-global.github.io/veritas-hospitality-advisors-site/owner-playbook.pdf): 15 frameworks for independent hotel owners
